correctness.rationale: Reciprocal substitution F(X)=X^n g(X+X^-1) is bijective for monic degree n g and translates squarefreeness exactly to squarefree g with g(2)g(-2)!=0 (ramification at ±1). Additive trace character series removes Y±2; in odd characteristic doubled nontrivial additive characters remain nontrivial, yielding R_psi(z)=1/[(1+psi(-2)z)(1+psi(2)z)]. Fourier orthogonality supplies M_{p,n}(c), modulo-q congruence gives integrality, and cycling the progression gives uniformity iff q=p and p|(n+1). Independently checked GF3 n=1..5 and GF5 n=1..4 (42 coefficient fibers), not claimed as universal proof.
residual_risks: Finite independent calculations do not establish untested infinite cases; unrestricted conclusions rest on proof lemmas.

final_claim: For odd q=p^r, degree 2n>=2 monic self-reciprocal squarefree polynomials coefficient c, N=(S-(-1)^n(n+1))/q+(-1)^n M_{p,n}(c); S=[z^n](1-qz^2)/((1-qz)(1+z)^2); M counts c=-2n+4j in Fp for 0<=j<=n. Uniform fibers iff q=p and p|(n+1).
limitations: Only odd-characteristic finite fields, positive even degrees, monic constant 1.
